criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1, 6 and 9 meet most of the 10 descriptor; counts on 1, 3 and 7 follow their declared scale. Held down by 2 (no tray, grey-green mid-tone floor, dead lower zone), 3 and 7 flat plates reading as a keyboard or chart, 7's raised cells tiny with faint casts, 5's joined core a rectangular box, duller teal lower strips on 9.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One floodlit hall, one cold key, one palette, cyan only for a Vista node; the tray motif changes state; 9 is the cover's reverse angle. Frame 2's grey-green floor sits slightly outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; c9 scoped honestly. Looser phrasings: slide 5 'the researchers call it the local detergent model of membrane fusion' goes past c13's quote; slide 2 'each node held two Intel Xeon processors' rests on c30 and doesn't cite c29; kicker 'TACC, Austin' and 'Vista, UT Austin' lean on c28's forecast; 'Frontera is dark' goes past retired. aggregates.json omits 130,000, 5.3 million and the caption's 64. No hard fail.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and roughly where; no decision, deadline or body deciding Horizon time; rhetorical closing question; stake general.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe; 6 is a real turn; 9 closes the loop; 3 restates the cover; 2 delays the payoff.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, restrained, honest; house rules hold; little regional texture; the caption's production note line is flat.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Floodlit world repeats nos. 70 and 59; one unit per thing count repeats 69, 71, 72; 72 was also a university biology computation story on molecular reliefs; Frontera and Horizon were no. 17's subject outside the window.

one_sentence_fix: Cut slide 3's restatement and end on something a Texan can act on rather than a rhetorical question, and bind slide 5's 'local detergent model of membrane fusion' to a quote that contains those words or cut the naming.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: No tray visible; grey-green mid-tone floor fills the bottom 40 percent.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower and closer so the tray walls and lip run off the edges; pull fog out of the floor.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat top-down plate reads as a keyboard; casts short and even.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rake the key low so trays throw long casts; carrier bleeds; eight cyan trays in a tighter pool.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Uniform mid-grey field; eight raised cells tiny; casts barely darker.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower key elevation for long casts; field albedo near black; bleed the field.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Joined core a hard-edged rectangle reads as a plug.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A curved hourglass stalk with a continuous core.
